install.method: install.sh piped over ssh; runs as a normal user, no sudo

smoke.description: one German triage chat completion through the tunnel at http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1, OpenAI-compatible, per-request x-opencode-session header, max_tokens=300, JSON-schema response format

example.reply_draft: Guten Tag, [NAME_1]. Wir freuen uns über Ihre Anfrage und sind bereit, Ihnen eine Konditionelle Angebotserstellung für die Reinigung Ihrer Büroräume in [POSTCODE_CITY_1] zu bereiten. Bitte kontaktieren Sie uns per E-Mail an [EMAIL_1] um weitere Informationen zu erhalten. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Anfrage und werden uns bei Ihnen sehr gerne angeschlossen fühlen. Vielen Dank für Ihre Aufmerksamkeit und bester Arbeit!

quality_notes: The JSON matches the schema, but the category is wrong: the enquiry asks for a cleaning quote (QUOTE_REQUEST) and the model answered JOB_APPLICATION.
The reply_draft carries the input placeholders but also invents [NAME_1], which was not in the prompt. Restore and guard steps must reject unknown placeholders.
German register is shaky ('Konditionelle Angebotserstellung', 'bester Arbeit'). Acceptable for a 1.5B model, not for unattended replies.

backend_check.description: the same request driven through ai_privacy_filter.backends.byok.BYOKBackend.for_ollama against the live backend, not just curl

example.reply_draft_omitted: transcript not quoted here: it mixed German, one Chinese sentence and invented placeholders

quality_notes: The backend path works end to end: availability true, no error kind, schema-valid JSON in 9.2 s.

Answer quality is poor: wrong category again (SUPPORT for a quote request), LOW urgency, invented placeholders ([Buero_Reinigung_Erstellung_Genossenschaft], [Triage-Assistent Name]) and one Chinese sentence.
The restore step must reject unknown placeholders, and local-model categories must not be treated as trustworthy without scoring.

memory.notes: peak is the systemd user-unit cgroup memory peak, which includes the model runner child process; the serve process alone stays under 30 MiB

fallback.reason: no OOM, 8.9 s per answer (limit 60 s), so qwen2.5:1.5b stays the default

privacy.note: connection details come only from AIPF_OLLAMA_SSH at run time; neither the scripts nor this file carry a host, IP, user or local path
